A manufacturing company which is presently growing at a good rate has 
a Financial Leverage of 3. Its present borrowings are as follows: 
12% Term Loan

` 20,00,000

1.0

1.5

suggested_answer: (B) Working Notes Calculation of Interest 12% Term Loan ` 7,20,000 Bank borrowings@10% ` 4,00,000 Public Deposits@8% ` 1,60,000 Total Interest ` 12,80,000 Financial Leverage = EBIT/EBIT – Interest 3 = EBIT/EBIT – 12,80,000 Or EBIT = 19,20,000 So, Interest Coverage Ratio = EBIT/Interest = 19,20,000/12,80,000 = 1.5
